cohort: 198 nulliparous women with a history of uterine septum and singleton pregnancies at >20 weeks gestation
finding: Hysteroscopic resection of the uterine septum in nulliparous women was associated with significantly reduced risks of preterm birth and malpresentations compared to usual care.
mod_finding: Hysteroscopic resection in nulliparous women with a septate uterus was associated with decreased risks of preterm birth and malpresentations compared to those who received usual care.
